name: page-source-spring
title: Page Source Spring
description: PageSource adapters for Spring Data: `Page<T>` (or the PagedModel of `VIA_DTO`) with page numbers and a total, and `Slice<T>` with previous and next, `?page=0&size=25&sort=name,asc`.
docs: `springPageSource({ key, getId, request, select })` sends Spring's `Pageable` params (0-based `page`, `size`, `sort=field,asc` repeated) and reads `content`, `totalElements` and `last` from `Page<T>` or the nested `page` of a PagedModel; `select(raw)` finds the page inside another envelope. `springSliceSource` reads a `Slice<T>` (`hasNext`, no count query), so the table shows previous and next. Pair it with `springFilter` from `filter-spring` for the filter. Each takes `params: (filter) => …` for a serializer's output and `maxPageSize`; return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError`.
